facts.fact: The World Bank's appraisal document says KfW was in the final stages of preparing a EUR 20 million E-Governance Project, contract signature expected by January 2025, to extend fibre optic connectivity in the southern region with the goal of connecting mayors' and prefects' offices.

facts.fact: The World Bank's appraisal document says the KfW E-Governance Project that is to connect mayors' and prefects' offices by fibre in the southern region is led by the Ministry of Digital Economy and Digital Transformation (MENTD).
